name: Shrapnel Burst
body:
Discipline: Metacreativity; Level: Psion/wilder 5, psychic warrior 4

MANIFESTING

Display: mental, visual
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Area: 40 ft. burst
Duration: instantaneous
Saving Throw: Reflex half; Power Resistance: No
Power Points: Psion/wilder 9, psychic warrior 7

DESCRIPTION

You emit a burst of crystalline shrapnel, dealing 9d6 points of piercing damage to all creatures within a 40 ft. burst centered on you.

Augment: For every additional power point you spend, the power deals an additional 1d6 points of damage. For every two additional dice of damage, the save DC is increased by 1.
